messages:
samantha: Heads-up: started prototyping SLO noise forecasting for the console. Goal: show expected daily alert volume per SLO & suggest notify channels per tenant. Thoughts?
aj: nice. how we calculate 'expected'? rolling 7d p95? :thinking_face:
devin: we're using traffic-weighted percentiles + incident-suppression windows. prototype uses 14d sliding window with 95th for burst and 50th for baseline.
sasha: Important: per-tenant quotas skew percentiles. Need to normalize by tenant request rate — otherwise low-traffic tenants look noisier.
observability-bot: deploy:noise-forecast v0.1 deployed to staging — /dash/noise-forecast
aj: UI ask: show 'expected alerts/day' and confidence band. Also allow toggling 'simulate with quiet window' to see reduction.
samantha: Agree. Also need API debate: where to store notify mapping? option A: in SLO config (slo.notifyChannels), option B: separate 'policy' resource mapping SLO->channels.
devin: Prefer separate policy resource. Keeps SLO pure (objective + threshold) and lets policies be shared across SLOs and tenants.
sasha: Edge-case: per-route can have dynamic routing (region fallback). Policy needs evaluation order and fallbacks. We should support templates with tenant vars.
aj: Policy API example: 
```yaml
policy_id: nightly-team-ops
match: tenant_id =~ /^(team-ops|infra)/
channels:
  - "#ops-oncall"
  - "#infra-watch"
suppression:
  quiet_window: '23:00-07:00'
  sample_rate: 0.1
```
devin: Also need server-side 'noise score' calc so console can preview impact of sample_rate & quiet_window before applying. Calculate expected delivered alerts = expected_alerts * (1 - suppression_coverage) * sample_rate.
samantha: UX: show 'estimated reductions' with small sparkline and link to 'why this is suggested' that explains normalization.
aj: :thumbsup: one more operational concern — alert fanout cost. We should show estimated cost delta (emails/SMS/ops time) when changing thresholds.
sasha: Implementation note: eval pipeline should be idempotent and fast. Cache last 1h aggregated volumes. If policy changes, re-eval on config commit.
devin: I'll open PR for policy schema and a small API to compute previews. Will include endpoint: `/api/v1/slo/preview_noise`.
samantha: Perfect. Next: meet Thurs 10am to review schema + staging UI. @aj @devin @sasha please add agenda items.
aj: Added. :memo:
